firmware.note: firmware/status serves a minimal envelope until a check has run since boot, then a state-dependent superset (~26 top-level keys, we model 10); the unmodelled remainder is exempted wholesale so canary results do not depend on when the box last ran a check. The 26.7 full-inventory keys (all_packages/all_sets) are a #227 opportunity

firmwareInfo.note: release changelog metadata, the full package inventory (~380 KB payload) and the product detail object; not modelled. First validated 2026-07-13 — before the ForceAttemptHTTP2 fix this endpoint always failed to probe over HTTP/1.1, so these keys never surfaced

hasyncVersion.note: present only for some HA peer states; box has no HA peer

healthCheck.note: legacy pre-26.1.11 health shape (top-level per-subsystem objects + metadata.<Subsystem>); 26.1.11+ serves only metadata.system plus metadata.subsystems, which the tolerant reader prefers. Prune when 26.1.10 and older leave the support window

protocolStatistics.note: cross-generation tcp counters. ecn ce/ect0/ect1-packets: renamed received-* in 26.1.11, legacy kept for ≤ 26.1.10 — prune when 26.1 leaves the support window. received-acks-for-unsent-data: split in 26.7 into received-acks-for-data-{not-yet-sent,never-been-sent,being-too-old}; decoded-only, no metric impact. syncache receivd-cookies/sent-cookies (upstream's typo included): moved to statistics.tcp.syncookies.* in 26.7; decoded-only, no metric impact. Prune the 26.7 pair when 26.1.11 leaves the support window; the new syncookies section stays unmodelled
